Meet Your Attorney

One Lawyer,
Start to Finish

Justin D. Leigh practices in downtown Spokane and is admitted in both Washington and Oregon. He runs the firm alone, so the person who takes your call is the person who handles your matter.

He handles real estate, business law, estate planning, personal injury, and criminal defense. When you hire Justin, you work directly with Justin, not a paralegal or an associate.

Justin is also a former brewery and winery owner. Alcohol beverage licensing is a substantial part of the practice, and he has held those licenses himself rather than only read about them.
